partial_criteria_notes.ac-256-turn: Live-codex turn verification is the operator sweep step in docs/pty-submit-sweep.md; the automatable part (submit_confirmed derived from PTY output, never from request fields) shipped with tests.

acceptance_criteria.text: An inject with submit:true to a live codex agent causes that agent to take a turn, verified from PTY output rather than request fields
Payloads >1KB submit as reliably as short ones
Repeated injects never stack unsent content in a composer
submit_bytes_written reflects a real write; submit_confirmed distinguishes delivered from merely typed
Regression test with a fake PTY asserting payload and Enter are separate writes, and that a bracketed payload is terminated before Enter is sent
HIVE_PTY_SUBMIT_GAP_MS keeps working as an override, with its restart-scoped caching documented
Two-call pattern documented as supported workaround; clean_message trailing-newline stripping documented

iteration_history.summary: Fresh run: 3-agent codex investigation, bracketed submit transport + honest receipts + submit_confirmed signal implemented, 857 tests green, PR #257 pushed
